facts.proposition: Sam Altman ruled out an OpenAI public listing in 2026, citing AI-safety concerns.
OpenAI is reportedly seeking at least $30 billion in private capital at a pre-money valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion.
OpenAI's annualized revenue is reported to be near $70 billion, more than 70% above the start of the current quarter.
